summary.name: VLC media player
summary.one_liner: VLC is a free, open source, cross-platform multimedia player and framework that plays most audio and video files and streaming protocols.
use_cases: play local video and audio files
play media without installing codec packs
use a free ad-free media player on Windows, Mac, or Linux
summary.what_it_does:
VLC is a multimedia player and framework maintained by the VideoLAN non-profit project. It plays files, discs, webcams, devices and streams. According to the page it plays most codecs without needing codec packs, including MPEG-2, MPEG-4, H.264, MKV, WebM, WMV and MP3. The page lists downloads for Windows, Windows Store, Mac OS X, iOS, Apple TV, Android, and several Linux distributions, and also offers the source code.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Plays most codecs with no codec packs needed
Plays discs, webcams, devices and network streams
No spyware, ads or user tracking, per the page
Developed by the non-profit VideoLAN project
caveats: The page does not state any limitations; the version shown is 3.0.24 for Windows (43 MB).
